## FTC Targets Amazon Over Alleged Billions in Advertising Overcharges

Whether framed as a threat or a filed suit, FTC action alleging billions in ad overcharges puts Amazon's high-margin advertising segment under regulatory scrutiny; the ambiguity in filing status across outlets is itself a risk — clarity on whether a complaint has been formally filed will determine the severity of the near-term impact on AMZN ad revenue and margin estimates.

- The FTC is reportedly threatening Amazon with a lawsuit over advertising pricing, with one headline describing alleged overcharges described as 'billions.'
- Outlets differ on filing status: one characterizes it as a lawsuit threat while another describes it as an active FTC lawsuit — the precise stage of the action is ambiguous across coverage.
- The action targets AMZN's advertising business directly.
- No confirmed dollar figure for alleged overcharges or penalties is specified beyond the general 'billions' characterization.
